DISC model in color coding:
- Red (Dominance) - assertive, direct, results-oriented, competitive, decisive, quick

- Green (Steadiness) - patient, accommodating, loyal, stable, supportive, good listener
- Blue (Compliance) - cautious, precise, detail-oriented, analytical, systematic, quality-focused

Actually, Red and Yellow might work well for getting things done, but Green and Blue are more compatible in the process. I'd say Green + Blue.

- Yellow and Blue: Yellow wants variety, Blue wants structure - can clash
- Green and Blue: both patient, systematic - good work compatibility
